summary: A full SZL 0x001C read, where the module type name and the serial number are the fields worth keeping and the plant and copyright strings are not identity.

device.description: Conpot running its default template, answering Read SZL as an IM151-8 PN/DP CPU
device.derivation: S7.request_ssl_28 in s7.py writes an SZL header declaring list 0x001C, a record length of 34 and a record count of 8, then eight records of a two byte data index followed by 32 bytes of null padded text. Each record uses a different mix of struct widths, 24s8s or 32s or 26s6s, but every combination totals 32. The strings come from the databus keys that s7comm.xml maps: SystemName, SystemDescription, FacilityName, Copyright, s7_id and s7_module_type, with the OEM id and the location left pointing at an empty key. s7_server.py wraps the result in an S7 user data message, a COTP data transfer and TPKT. The template binds port 10201 because the process is unprivileged; deployments front it on 102, which is the port recorded here.
